comment.body:
Thanks for confirming this still occurs on 0.101.2432 and for adding the screenshots. Earlier reports in this thread used Scoop or Chocolatey, and switching to the official GitHub installer resolved the warning, but your installation source is not clear from the latest comment.

Could you tell us whether this PowerToys installation came from the GitHub installer, Microsoft Store, WinGet, Scoop, Chocolatey, or another package, and copy the folder path shown by Task Manager > PowerToys > Open file location? If it came from the official GitHub, Store, or WinGet package, please reproduce the prompt and then comment `/bugreport` immediately afterward so the fresh diagnostic ZIP is attached.
